qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the fuel injector to intake manifold?
qa_pairs.answer: 10 Nm using an M6 screw for all applications.

qa_pairs.question: What screw size is used for mounting the fuel injector to the intake manifold?
qa_pairs.answer: M6 screw is used for mounting the fuel injector to the intake manifold.

qa_pairs.question: Which engine types require the 25 Nm torque specification for the coupling nut on fuel injector?
qa_pairs.answer: All applications with K-Jetr require the 25 Nm torque specification.

qa_pairs.question: What section of the manual covers fuel delivery and metering system specifications?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 13-8 covers fuel delivery and metering system specifications.

qa_pairs.question: What is the item number for fuel injectors in this specification table?
qa_pairs.answer: The item number for fuel injectors is 13 64.

qa_pairs.question: What are the two specific fuel injector components listed with torque specifications?
qa_pairs.answer: The two components are: fuel injector to intake manifold (1AZ) and coupling nut on fuel injector (2AZ).

qa_pairs.question: What units are used for the torque measurements in this fuel injector specification table?
qa_pairs.answer: Newton meters (Nm) are used for all torque measurements in this table.

qa_pairs.question: Which fuel injector torque specification applies to all engine types without restriction?
qa_pairs.answer: The fuel injector to intake manifold specification of 10 Nm applies to all engine types without restriction.

qa_pairs.question: What is the difference in torque values between the fuel injector mounting and the coupling nut?
qa_pairs.answer: The coupling nut requires 25 Nm while the fuel injector mounting requires 10 Nm, a difference of 15 Nm.
